verdict.rationale: Alloy is an identity, fraud and compliance SaaS platform rather than an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server or endpoint. The Events API, webhooks, an llms.txt docs index and marketing about 'agentic automation' are adjacent features, not an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
